author: Colecrc
body:
Hello,
A couple of minutes ago I was banned off TS by ALM for "(Please do not spam over poke/PM)", to which I admit I did spam because I wanted to speak to him about some suggestions for the TS. While I at first I poked him a few times he simply ignored me, so I then I proceeded to spam him to get his attention for about six secs then I stopped. I was being without any warning or any previous kicks that could warrant a two-hour ban, and I believed I deserved to be warned or kicked before being banned for two hours.
Regards,
Jewnor
